list_webhooks: list all webhooks for the current authenticated user on the Hugging Face Hub
create_webhook: create a new webhook on the Hugging Face Hub with a URL or job-id and watched items
update_webhook: update an existing webhook's URL, watched items, domains, or secret by its ID
enable_webhook: enable a previously disabled webhook on the Hugging Face Hub by its ID
delete_webhook: delete a webhook permanently from the Hugging Face Hub by its ID with optional confirmation
